inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum over the 2009 agreement should be understood as a warning about years of unresolved obligations, not simply as union leaders holding students hostage. Students and families are right to worry about disruption, but blaming workers for using their collective leverage shifts attention from the government’s failure to meet its commitments. A just settlement must protect students’ education and workers’ rights—and address the institutional neglect that keeps turning disputes into crises.
